notice: Potential NL and international shopping research entry points. Listing is not current price verification, delivery proof or a promise of accessibility.

rules.discovery: Community/folders identify leads, never prove price or discount.
rules.marketplace: Must check seller, condition, NL delivery and exact variant.
rules.comparator: Can triangulate prices and history, but merchant page or reliable product-level feed required.
rules.discount: Advertised percentage, MSRP and cross-shop price differences alone are not seller's documented 30-day discount.
rules.crossBorder: For EU evaluate NL VAT/shipping and return warranty; outside EU require verified VAT/import duties/clearance/fx before claiming all-in.
rules.physical: Within 20 km Bleiswijk only with verified store address and branch-specific price/stock.
rules.quality: Storebrand and budget products fully eligible if adequate quality, compare cost per use.
